jobs.title: Senior Brand Marketing Manager, Mako EMEA
jobs.description:
Location:
Amsterdam, Netherlands

Why join us?

At Stryker, Mako Robotics is transforming orthopaedic surgery through technology, data and innovation. As we continue to accelerate robotic adoption across EMEA, we are looking for an experienced marketing leader to shape the future of one of our fastest-growing strategic platforms.

This is a highly visible leadership opportunity for someone who thrives in complex international environments and enjoys bringing people together around a shared commercial vision.

Joint Replacement:
Joint replacement | Stryker

What You'll Do

As Senior Brand Marketing Manager, Mako EMEA, you will be responsible for defining and executing the regional brand strategy that drives adoption, customer engagement and long-term portfolio growth.

Working across Europe and in close partnership with Global Marketing, Product Management, Sales Leadership and local marketing teams, you will ensure Mako remains at the centre of our Joint Replacement growth strategy.

You will:

Develop and execute the long-term EMEA Mako brand strategy
Integrate Mako into annual marketing plans across the Knee and Hip portfolios
Lead pan-EMEA marketing campaigns and customer engagement initiatives
Partner with US upstream and downstream marketing teams to align global and regional priorities
Build strong relationships with local marketing teams, commercial leaders and key opinion leaders
Develop scalable marketing assets and programmes that can be localised across Europe
Support product lifecycle management, launches and portfolio growth initiatives
Analyse market performance and identify opportunities to accelerate growth
Mentor and develop Brand Marketing team members
Influence senior stakeholders across multiple business units within a complex matrix organisation

Who We're Looking For

You are an experienced marketing leader with the credibility to influence senior stakeholders across functions, countries and business units.

You bring:

Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred)
10+ years of professional experience
Significant experience within medical devices
Strong background in Capital Equipment and/or Robotics marketing or commercial roles
Previous people leadership experience
Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills
Strong commercial acumen and strategic thinking
Experience working successfully in complex international matrix organisations
Fluent English communication skills

Why this role?

This is more than a marketing leadership position.

You'll play a central role in shaping the future of robotic surgery across EMEA, influencing commercial strategy, partnering with global teams, and helping drive the continued growth of one of Stryker's most important strategic platforms.

Netherlands Pay Ranges:

Netherlands: €83.100 - €154.400 EUR Annual

At Stryker, we believe transparency helps candidates make confident decisions about their next career step. Compensation is an important part of that process and we want to be clear about how pay is determined. The compensation information posted for this role may be presented as a salary range or a fixed amount depending on the role. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for incentive compensation (such as bonus and/or commissions where applicable), along with Stryker’s comprehensive benefits package.

If you’d like to learn more about the salary or the benefits associated with this role, your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details as you progress through the hiring process.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

jobs.title: Brand Manager Dairy DACH (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About The Job

You love strong brands - we love strong personalities! Become part of Danone and our team with the successful brands Volvic, Activia, Actimel, Alpro and more.

Identifying new growth areas, consumer needs and market opportunities by leading the development of a new brand platform for Dairy DACH.
Responsible for the strategy and activation of the new brand platform based on analyses of local growth areas and current EU/global team pipelines.
Setting up and realizing strategic priorities through insights, detailed target group, market, and competitive analyses.
Strong drive & contribution to define the portfolio setup and design, brand equity development, route-to-market definition, and activation.
Engage & lead in cross-functional project teams within the DACH cluster and collaborate with the EU/Global team

About You

Successfully completed studies in business administration or comparable
At least 3 years of professional experience in brand management of consumer goods, ideally within the food & beverage category
Very good project management skills and experience in the implementation of media campaigns and product innovations
Entrepreneurial curious thinking, enjoy making decisions and finding innovative and creative solutions.
Strong ownership and high self-motivation, as well as a positive mindset.
High agility regarding different market conditions, competitive environments, and seizing opportunities.
Convincing and inspiring personality with confidence in presentation and pitching ideas.
Fluent in German and English

Start date is July in Frankfurt am Main
, Munich
, Nuremberg or Vienna
– with the option to work flexibly from home.

About Us

OWN your IDEAS

In our culture, respect and team spirit are embedded at all levels the best idea is not determined by the hierarchical level.

OWN your CAREER

Your career path is not a one-way street. Individual career plans give you freedom and flexibility We support you - e.g. with our coaching and mentoring offer.

OWN your IMPACT

A job means so much more than titles and earning money. With us you have the opportunity to really make a difference and improve the health of people and the planet.

Come to Danone and make our team even more colorful and diverse. We say bring your very own self into our teams - because we count on the individuality of everyone. #Dan'OwnYourUniqueness

Your Benefits

Mobile and flexible working
Various education opportunities
Pension
Pick & Choose from the categories Transportation, Health, Childcare and more!

jobs.title: Art Director Performance Creatives (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Performancepixel ist eine Performance Design Agentur im DACH Raum. Wir entwickeln datengetriebene Ad Creatives, Creative Strategien und skalierbare Produktionsprozesse für Social Ads, vor allem auf Meta und TikTok.

Wir suchen einen Art Director, der zwei Sachen mitbringt: ein richtig starkes kreatives Auge und die Fähigkeit, Zahlen zu lesen. Du entwickelst nicht einfach schöne Designs, du entwickelst Creative Strategien, die auf Daten basieren. Der Kunde schickt eine Kampagne, du gehst in die Tiefe und baust die Strategie dahinter. Und du leitest unser Creative Team an, damit aus der Strategie skalierbare Ads werden.

Wichtig vorab: Wir arbeiten nicht mit Adobe. Unser Setup basiert auf Claude, Figma und Higgsfield. Wenn du Bock hast, mit einem der modernsten AI Workflows im Creative Bereich zu arbeiten, bist du hier richtig.

Aufgaben

Creative Strategien entwickeln: Der Kunde schickt eine Kampagne, du arbeitest die Strategie dahinter aus, mit einem großen Research Anteil

Wettbewerbsresearch: Welche Ads schalten die Wettbewerber, wie sind die aufgebaut, welche Arten von Ads funktionieren aktuell auf den Plattformen

Creative Deconstruction: Ads systematisch zerlegen und verstehen, welche Hooks funktionieren, was Aufmerksamkeit erzeugt und wie man die Zielgruppe bestmöglich abholt

Performance Analyse im Ads Manager: Welche Ads laufen gut, welche nicht, Learnings ableiten und daraus neue Strategien und Testing Ansätze entwickeln

Kampagnenkonzepte, Testing Strategien und Messaging Ansätze für unsere Kunden erarbeiten

Anleitung und Weiterentwicklung des Creative Teams (Grafikdesigner, Motion Designer, Video Editoren, Copywriter)

Qualitätssicherung aller Werbemittel, visuell und performance-seitig, inklusive Safe Zones und plattformgerechter Umsetzung

Creative Reportings und Strategy Präsentationen für Kunden erstellen und präsentieren

Deinen eigenen Workflow mit AI Tools ständig weiterentwickeln und Learnings ins Team tragen

Qualifikation

3+ Jahre Erfahrung in Art Direction, Creative Strategy oder Creative Lead Rollen im Performance Marketing oder Agenturumfeld

Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Ad Creative Konzepten für Meta, TikTok o.ä. (PFLICHT, bitte im Portfolio zeigen)

Du kannst mit Zahlen arbeiten: Ads Manager Daten lesen, CTR, Hook Rate, ROAS interpretieren und daraus Strategien ableiten

Du verstehst, wie der Algorithmus arbeitet, wie Ads aktuell funktionieren und worin sich die Plattformen unterscheiden

Du bist hochkreativ und entwickelst unike Ideen, keine Copy Paste Ads

AI Skills: Du bist mit Tools wie Claude, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs und Co vertraut und hast Bock, deinen Workflow ständig zu verbessern (unser Fokus liegt auf Claude, Figma und Higgsfield)

Führungserfahrung: Du hast bereits ein kreatives Team angeleitet

Fähigkeit, kreative Ideen klar und überzeugend vor Kunden zu präsentieren

Du beschäftigst dich auch privat mit Social Ads, Trends und Plattform Updates

Sprache: Deutsch mind. C1, Englisch mind. B2

Benefits

Arbeite mit einem der modernsten AI Creative Workflows der Branche (Claude, Figma, Higgsfield)

Arbeite mit Marken, die Creative ernst nehmen (u.a. MyMüsli, Olavson, Elotrans etc.)

Remote-first, flexible Arbeitszeiten

Datengetriebenes Umfeld, jede kreative Entscheidung wird messbar

Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung

Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft

JobRad

Mehrere Workations pro Jahr

Regelmäßige Team Events

Gestaltungsspielraum: Du formst die kreative Ausrichtung der Agentur mit

Unser Prozess:

Bewerbung einreichen (CV + Portfolio/Case Studies)

Kennenlerngespräch mit Gerrit (GF)

Strategy Case (bezahlt)

Finales Gespräch + Rahmenbedingungen

Zusätzliche Infos:

Arbeitsplatz: Remote oder Hybrid (Deutschland)

Art der Beschäftigung: Vollzeit / Freelance

Jobkategorie: Design und Architektur → Grafik- und Kommunikationsdesign

Karrierestufe: Senior / Lead

Fähigkeiten: Art Direction, Creative Strategy, Performance Marketing, Meta Ads, Creative Analytics, AI Tools, Team Leadership

jobs.title: Tech Lead Marketing Automation (Accenture Song)
jobs.description:
Accenture Song
es el lugar donde se diseñan experiencias que ayudan a mejorar la vida de las personas. Reimaginamos las industrias, productos y servicios. Si crees que nuestros clientes solo ganarán relevancia a través de la tecnología y la digitalización, tu lugar está con nosotros.

Tu misión

Incorporarte al equipo de Data Tech de Accenture Song
para liderar iniciativas de Marketing Automation
sobre Adobe Experience Cloud
(p. ej., Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Experience Platform - RTCDP
). También valoraremos experiencia demostrable en Salesforce Marketing Cloud
y Pega
. Dispondrás de itinerarios de formación propia en la solución
para acelerar tu rampa en proyecto.

Responsabilidades clave

Responsable tecnológico de equipos de delivery / equipos de trabajo, asegurando calidad técnica, governance y cadencia de valor

Gestión de proyectos y gobierno de metodología, con manejo de herramientas de planificación y seguimiento.

Trabajo con integraciones en arquitecturas de gestión de campañas

Conocimientos técnicos de desarrollo de aplicaciones y bases de datos (SQL/NoSQL), y programación aplicada a MarTech (p. ej., Javascript, Python).

Interlocución con equipos de IT y de negocio, traduciendo entre necesidades del negocio y soluciones técnicas.

Participación en proyectos de asesoramiento tecnológico y grupos de innovación de transformación digital.

Análisis, diseño y construcción de Modelos de Datos

Diseño de integraciones de Marketing Automation con canales del cliente

Configuración y personalización de herramientas de Marketing Automation

Desarrollo de APIs propias y consumo de APIs externas

Interlocución con el cliente (equipos IT y Negocio)

Generación de documentación técnica

Generación y ejecución del plan de pruebas

Requisitos:

5–8 años de experiencia en MarTech/Marketing Automation, y 2+ años liderando equipos técnicos.

Experiencia práctica con Adobe Experience Cloud (AEP, AJO, AEP/RT‑CDP...) o plataformas equivalentes.

Sólidos conocimientos de modelado de datos, SQL y arquitecturas orientadas a campañas y audiencias.

Experiencia en integraciones

Capacidad de gestión de proyectos

Valorable:

Experiencia en Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Data Extensions) y/o Pega (Customer Decision Hub).

Conocimiento de CDPs y estrategias Customer 360.

Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) y prácticas DevOps (CI/CD, IaC), y test automation.

Gobierno de privacy & consent y deliverability

Certificaciones: Adobe, Salesforce, Pega, Agile/PMI...

Lo que ofrecemos:

Proyectos de alto impacto con marcas líderes y en ecosistema Adobe.

Itinerarios de formación y certificación en las plataformas clave y comunidades internas de práctica.

Entorno diverso e inclusivo, con impacto real en la transformación digital de nuestros clientes.

Además, tendrás otros BENEFICIOS
como:

Seguro médico, de Vida y accidentes

Servicio médico y programas de bienestar

Programa de retribución flexible y compra de acciones

Programas de flexibilidad (horaria, de días libres, vacaciones...)

Itinerario formativo individualizado

Programas de sostenibilidad y Fundación Accenture

Red de empleados por la diversidad

Otros beneficios: Oficina Bankinter con condiciones especiales y reparto de beneficios

jobs.title: Project Leader / Principal, Insurance, Spain
jobs.description:
Locations
: Madrid | Barcelona

Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

Lead multidisciplinary teams in delivering end-to-end transformations across clients' claims, pricing and underwriting functions
Drive end-to-end transformation programs, working across strategy consultants, data scientists, data engineers and solution architects to deliver scalable, end-to-end solutions
Collaborate with global, multidisciplinary teams to support insurance transformation projects across international engagements
Work closely with global leaders of BCG's global initiative focused on transforming clients' claims, pricing and underwriting functions, contributing to a global specialist squad
Contribute to large-scale insurance transformation programs, with opportunities to work on international engagements under BCG's travel standards

What You'll Bring

At least 8 years of professional experience, including at least 3 years in insurance technical excellence functions such as pricing, claims or underwriting
Previous consulting experience is preferred; experience in insurance companies, insurance assistance companies or insurance consulting firms is highly valued
Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree or MBA is a plus
Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills to solve complex business challenges and deliver impactful client solutions
Proven ability to build relationships and manage stakeholders across different levels of seniority
Fluency in English and Spanish
